summary: ConfigError accepts only (code, location); message is always defaultMessage(code, location)—no free-form message argument.
details: F2 / #38 hardening: constructor is ConfigError(code: ConfigErrorCode, location: ConfigErrorLocation). Error.message comes solely from defaultMessage(code, location). formatConfigErrorLine still emits code + safe location. Do not reintroduce a third message parameter.

summary: N-UNIT-01, N-UNIT-08, and N-ACC-09 assert redaction by feeding secret-like values through real path/error APIs, not only by constructing ConfigError directly.
details: Value-fed cases pass SECRET_URL/SECRET_PATH-like strings into resolveConfigPath and related failure paths, then assert ConfigError.message and formatConfigErrorLine omit those values. N-UNIT-08 also asserts ConfigError.length === 2 (no free-form message arg). Prefer this pattern for future config-error secrecy coverage.

summary: F2 (ConfigError + path QA hardening) lands before #47 and unblocks #38 T3-scope close after evidence.
details: Delivery branch f2/error-path-hardening. Scope: remove free-form ConfigError messages; harden N-UNIT-01/08 and N-ACC-09 with value-fed redaction. Sequencing constraint: merge/land F2 before #47. After CI/test evidence, #38 T3-scope can close.
